policy: Generic species/role keys and unsuffixed named characters are kept at identity-family level unless the digital key itself supplies enough scene, era, outfit, or component detail. Same-year prelaunch releases are temporally possible but are not automatically source-equivalent; explicit novelty and post-game variants remain separate.

systemic_findings: Generic species keys such as Weequay should remain role/species families unless scene or individual identity is independently established.
Duplicate catalog records caused by part-mold revisions should be distinguished from true narrative/outfit variants.
Same-year prelaunch physical figures are temporally possible counterparts but still need semantic/visual evidence before exact equivalence.
